Packages
```{r}
library("sf")
library("dplyr")
library("librarian")
library("here")
```

Shapefile- Download and Read Files

```{r}
rest2026_dir <- here::here('data/ecoatlas_sitefunding_20261116_131730')

# Check if directory exists; if not, create it and pull data
if(!dir.exists(rest2026_dir)) {
    dir.create(rest2026_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
delta_dir<-here::here('data/Legal_Delta')
# Check if directory exists; if not, create it and pull data
if(!dir.exists(delta_dir)) {
    dir.create(delta_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
Restoration_Nov26<- read_sf(here("data/ecoatlas_sitefunding_20261116_131730/habitatprojects_sites_activities_funding.shp"))
Legal_Delta_boundary<- read_sf(here("data/Legal_Delta/Legal_Delta_SM.shp"))
```

#Checking geography- both are CA Albers
```{r}
st_crs(Restoration_Nov26)
st_crs(Legal_Delta_boundary)
```

Quick look at the Restoration Data
```{r}
glimpse(Restoration_Nov26)
```

Trying to Clip Restoration to Delta
```{r}
Delta_union <- st_union(Legal_Delta_boundary)
rest26_clipped <- st_intersection(Restoration_Nov26, Delta_union)
```
